items: A three-point arc: it starts at (x1, z1), ends at (x2, z2) and passes through (x3, z3), all in metres from the record. The default is a quarter circle of radius 3 m.
A closed ring through the corners in pts, metres from the record (the first corner is [0, 0]). The default is a 4 m square.
An open polyline through the points in pts, metres from the record. The default is a three-point path 4 m across.
